title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Orbán
author: Office of the Spokesman
summary:
Office of the Spokesman

Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Orbán

Readout

October 29, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán to discuss energy diversification, law enforcement and cybersecurity cooperation, and multilateral priorities. At the meeting, Secretary Rubio and Foreign Minister Orbán signed two memoranda of understanding, codifying Hungary’s commitment to energy diversification under the Trump Peace Pipelines Framework (TPPF) and a bilateral commitment to combatting far-left terrorism.
